kurz: A topic collects all decisions about one system – “saving” or “map look”, for example – and has a maintained summary “applies now”. Nobody has to read old decisions one by one.
brauchst: A maintainer: the agent who writes the summary and keeps it up to date.

schritte.text: The maintainer writes it with `amw thema pflegen <topic> --text-datei <file>`.
When a new decision about the topic is added, the summary counts as outdated. The maintainer updates it or confirms it with `amw thema bestaetigen <topic>`.

fehler: A newer decision is not in the summary yet. The maintainer is reminded.
danach: One topic can be the project style (`amw thema einstellen <topic> --stil`); all agents then see it in their start information.
